dairy_product_yields_capri.note: Without the dairy block, butter, SMP, cheese and whey per tonne of raw milk at CAPRI's member-state 2030 yields (dairy_processing.csv) instead of FAO EU averages (cheese 0.0456 vs CAPRI 0.068).

bilateral_market_capri.note: CAPRI's market model (arm/market_model.gms): market price per region, two Armington nests (rho1, rho2 from market1.gms / market1_ch.gms) over CAPRI's bilateral flows priced at exporter price + transport + tariffs (impPrice_ aggregated at the base composition); data of the run's market year (2017 base market, 2030 reference). Replaces one world price per commodity with an EU Armington premium. REGISTERED: augmented-CES commitment terms, global quotas.

eu_trq_capri.note: EU bilateral tariff-rate quotas with CAPRI's sigmoid (trqSigmoidFunc_, slope 200 around 97% of the quota); in the 2030 reference the meat quotas are far from filled and do not bind under Farm-to-Fork.

market_products_capri.note: Market products follow CAPRI's traded ones: wheat = soft + durum (durum's price follows), olive oil (olives x member-state yield), milled rice (paddy x EU ratio 0.40) (processing_yields.csv); the invented durum world market removed.

projection_livestock_yields.note: The 2030 projection scaled the yields table but output per head came from 2017 coefficients (a 2030 cow gave 2017 milk; EU farm milk 10% below CAPRI's 2030 reference). Output and revenue per head now follow the projected yield (dairy cows: milk part), and requirements follow it (dairy cows: breeding.gms functions; manure N per kg milk).

projection_trajectory_keys.note: CAPRI's trend projection (captrd_2030.json) is keyed by CAPRI names and regions; the projection read it by model names and NUTS 2021 regions, so differing names (CORN/MAIZ, WINE/TWIN, BULL/BULF ...) took the activity default and 246 of 248 regions the EU median. Model keys added (tools/build/build_trajectory_model_keys.py); crop areas now follow CAPRI's trend levels per activity (the herds block carries LEVL for crops too).

biofuel_markets_endogenous.note: Sprint 9c: CAPRI's endogenous biofuel markets (BIOF_M, star 3.0 GUI default; arm/prep_market.gms p_endoBioMarket=1). BIOE and BIOD are market commodities: SupplyBiof_ (sigmoid x double-log on biofPriceRel = producer price / CES feedstock cost), MaprBiof_ (+ fixed NAGR, SECG, EXOG), biofDemShare_/biofDem_ (QUTS + sigmoid in consumer price / fossil price, x total fuel use in oil equivalents), Cpri_ (additive tax and margin), bilateral trade (special_ch/market1_ch.gms rho1 2.2, rho2 4.5), per CAPRI market region, calibrated as biofuel/def_biofuel_params.gms to the 2030 Green Deal reference (tools/build/build_biofuel_market.py, market/biofuel_market.csv). CAPRI's HCON is total fuel use: dump HCOM of GASL/DISL is the fossil part, HCON = HCOM + BIOF oilEqu_b/oilEqu_f (reproduces data_market_1730defaulta HCON CAL and HCOS). Output and use reproduced in every region. Scenario setting PolicyScenario.biofuel_markets (default on), held for the baseline. Farm-to-Fork 2030: EU ethanol -4.3%, biodiesel -1.4%; gap 3.29 -> 3.32. The items registered in Sprint 9c (DDGS, non-fuel processing, mandates) are closed by biofuel_loop_ddgs_feed_bulks (Sprint 9d). docs/BIOFUEL_MARKET.md.

biofuel_loop_ddgs_feed_bulks.note: Sprint 9d: the biofuel loop closed as CAPRI. DDGS market commodity: output = sum cereal feedstock x PRCBY (prodQuantBiofBy_, CAPRI's 2030 output reproduced in every region), bilateral trade (market1_ch.gms rho1 1.2, rho2 2.4), producer price in biofFeedCost_; a market without BIOF_M too. CAPRI's feed bulks for the member states (feedBlkPrice_, feedShareEqu_; tools/build/build_feed_bulks.py, market/feed_bulks_eu.csv): FCER and FPRO split into products by CES rho 6 (arm/market1.gms p_rhoFeed RMSSUP) on EU Arm1 prices, bulk from the member state's herds and rations, bulk price index to the rations and per-head feed costs; replaces the single EU cereal and cake indices. Non-EU DDGS feed demand from p_ElasFeed; feed_demand_nonEU.json now built by tools/build/build_feed_demand_nonEU.py (reproduces the earlier 125 entries exactly, adds DDGS and Ethiopia). Non-fuel ethanol processing ProcNQ_ (p_hessNQProc own term / INPE). Mandate shock PolicyScenario.biofuel_mandate (change_biof_mandate.gms). Farm-to-Fork 2030: gap 3.31; baseline domestic-use median deviation 3.7%. REGISTERED: FPRI and fish meals in FPRO at reference prices; glycerine 600 EUR/t (as CAPRI); Norway's bulks not split. docs/BIOFUEL_MARKET.md.

inner_fert_model_mineral_redu.note: Sprint 9e: CAPRI's inner fertiliser distribution model (useInnerFertDistModel, star 3.0 default; supply/set_fert_priors.gms, e_focFertDist, NUTNED_, fertDistExcr_, fertDistCres_) on its 2030 priors (environment/fert_dist_priors_2030.csv: crop-level dump flows summed to the 17 NGRP groups, postModePerHa reproduced to 4e-5 against priFertDist, accuracy 1), capri_mod/fert/inner_fert_dist.py; results['fert_dist'] per region and group. Green Deal mineRedu (minfert_redu_uaa.gms e_synNMax; minfert_redu_by_crop.gms nMax_ with the f2f and limCres beta regulations, CAPRI's exemptions read from the file by year: policy/mineral_redu_exemptions.csv, mineral_redu_limcres.csv): a mineral-N row in each EU regional model from the balance's own linear coefficients, per-group caps entering through their sum. Fix: fertiliser technologies in the conic model act on the crops' mineral rate (they acted on the whole unit coefficient incl. manure-covered need). REGISTERED: per-group caps aggregated (manure reallocation); ammonia technologies' extra field N not on the mineral row; techs outside the conic model respond to the N-balance price only. docs/FERTILISER_ALLOCATION.md.

dairy_block_star3.note: Sprint 9f: CAPRI's dairy block on by default (part of CAPRI's market model). FRMI, CREM, COCM, WMIO, CASE traded bilaterally as in CAPRI (bilateral_flows/regions 2017 and 2030 from CAPRI's market results via tools/build/build_bilateral_market.py; world prices FAO_agg World PMRK BAS; world balances FAO_agg via tools/build/build_dairy_world_markets.py; Armington rho1/rho2 market1_ch.gms and own-price p_ElasDem weighted by food use, tools/build/build_dairy_trade_params.py). Raw milk, fat and protein prices per member state (FatsProtBal_, ProcMargM_, DairyNQ_ per RMS; raw milk not traded), regional models paid their member state's milk price. Extraction needs careful decoding of AGLINK code system (EU codes EUE/EUN, hundreds of measure codes). A real task, not a quick win. CSVs 177M+58M not stored (too large); xlsx notes kept.
uploaded_star_files_assessment.conclusion: All four are genuine CAPRI/source data (good to have, stored as provenance), but NONE is a clean drop-in replacement for the two synthetic files (feed_requirements needs per-head requirements; nutrient_coefs needs fertilizer rates). The validator still correctly flags those 2 as synthetic.

capreg_extraction_outcome._summary: Successfully extracted real capreg data (fert_out: 32236 rows, feed coeff: 71902 rows, all 35 MS, NUTS-2). Stored in sources/capri_star/capreg_extracts/. However, NEITHER cleanly replaces its synthetic file:
capreg_extraction_outcome.fert_out: Single undocumented value per region x crop (CAPRI source literally says "needs explanatory text and meta data"). Model nutrient_coefs needs N/P2O5/K2O split into 3. Cannot responsibly split one unknown value into three nutrients. NOT applied.
capreg_extraction_outcome.feed_coeff: p_pmpFeedInpCoeff is a LINEAR FUNCTION (CNST intercept + SLOP) per region x animal x feedtype, at CAPRI feed-group aggregation (FCER/FGRA/FMAI...). Two problems: (1) mapping CAPRI feed groups to model commodity items is lossy (FCER=all cereals cannot resplit to SWHE/BARL/CORN); (2) the CNST intercept alone is NOT the per-head requirement - interpreting it as such gives implausible values (dairy cow grass 0.024 vs realistic ~3.5 t DM/head/yr). The synthetic template is actually MORE realistic than a naive CNST mapping. NOT applied.
capreg_extraction_outcome.conclusion: The extraction pipeline now works (major milestone - can pull any capreg symbol to CSV). But these two specific symbols are structurally different from what the model needs: fert_out is undocumented/single-valued, feed coeff is a linear-function form at wrong aggregation. Replacing the synthetic files properly needs either (a) the CAPRI feed model context to evaluate the linear function into per-head intakes, or (b) a different symbol (e.g. p_feedDetail or the SUA feed use). The real data is stored for future use.
